Game Overview

At its heart, Loop Ghost is a puzzle game about quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Playing Loop Ghost comes down to a simple loop. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Loop Ghost?

Loop Ghost is a free puzzle game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Loop Ghost free to play?

Yes, Loop Ghost is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
